edits.new:
The ten legacy criteria AC1 to AC10 of RWB-E2-041 are owned by RWB-P3-E2041-APP and are not restated. The fifteen below are new under D-RCV-60 and test only the registry half: the checklist on the version, the approval gate, the change report and the counts. Every value inside them is a legacy value of RWB-E2-041 sections 3, 4, 7, 8 and 12. The scope is the rule package versions (LOADED, APPROVED, IN_FORCE); the reference-data change checklist and its report stay with RWB-E1-043. AC16 and AC17 below, for the 401 and 404 answers, are a separate block of this section.

```gherkin
Feature: Rule change governance and audit report in rwb-decision (AC16 and AC17)

  Scenario: AC16 The report refuses a read without a token (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given no authenticated user is calling
    When GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/admin/rule-packages/change-report for 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31 with packageCode ALLOCATION is called without a token
    Then the call is refused with 401 and the message code Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P7-E2041-APP-AC12)
    Then no data is returned and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC17 The approve of an unknown version is refused with 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given no rule package version has the identifier given as versionId
    When "U-51" calls POST /api/recovery/decision/v1/admin/rule-package-versions/{versionId}/approve with an unknown versionId
    Then the call is refused with 404 and the message code Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P7-E2041-APP-AC12)
    Then no approver is written and no decision record of an approval is written
```
